edges.label: Vanderbilt UAP statistician invited to a Pentagon-sponsored expert meeting
edges.note: Vanderbilt University Medical Center reports that Stephen Bruehl, PhD, professor of Anesthesiology, 'was invited to attend a Pentagon-sponsored meeting for discussions with UAP experts from the government and academia' in August 2025, as his cluster analysis of 216 well-documented UAP cases (1947-2016) neared publication in World Futures. The sponsoring office is not named in the source.

title: Stephen Bruehl, cluster-analysis study of 216 UAP cases, World Futures, published online October 1, 2025 (title not given in the VUMC source)
